answer: To defeat Sybil swarms, our economy binds identities to cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. Swarm nodes trying to forge valid proof chains face an exponential stake bonding curve: creating identity N requires 2^N capital, guaranteeing exponential capital exhaustion. An agent might analyze a sonnet or detect a violet wavelength to prove verified compute, but attackers cannot clone state without compounding cost.
